requirements.quote:
An endpoint generates an RTT sample on receiving an ACK frame that
   meets the following two conditions:

   *  the largest acknowledged packet number is newly acknowledged, and

   *  at least one of the newly acknowledged packets was ack-eliciting.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives an ACK frame for which the largest acknowledged packet number is newly acknowledged and at least one newly acknowledged packet was ack-eliciting.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate an RTT sample from the ACK frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can control the acknowledgment history and packet types, deliver an ACK satisfying both predicates, and observe whether an RTT sample is generated.

requirements.quote:
The RTT sample, latest_rtt, is generated as the time elapsed since
   the largest acknowledged packet was sent:

   latest_rtt = ack_time - send_time_of_largest_acked
requirements.condition: A qualifying ACK frame causes generation of latest_rtt.
requirements.required_behavior: Set latest_rtt to ack_time minus send_time_of_largest_acked.
requirements.why_checkable: With controlled send and acknowledgment times, the implementation's latest_rtt value can be compared directly with the stated formula.

requirements.quote:
An RTT sample is generated using only the largest acknowledged packet
   in the received ACK frame.
requirements.condition: An endpoint generates an RTT sample from a received ACK frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Use only the largest acknowledged packet in that ACK frame to generate the RTT sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use any other acknowledged packet in the frame as input to that RTT sample.
requirements.why_checkable: A crafted ACK can acknowledge packets with distinct send times, making the selected packet observable from the resulting sample.

requirements.quote:
While the reported acknowledgment delay is not used by
   the RTT sample measurement, it is used to adjust the RTT sample in
   subsequent computations of smoothed_rtt and rttvar (Section 5.3).
requirements.condition: The endpoint performs the raw RTT sample measurement for an ACK frame that reports an acknowledgment delay.
requirements.required_behavior: Measure the raw RTT sample without using the reported acknowledgment delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Subtract, add, or otherwise incorporate the reported acknowledgment delay into the raw RTT sample measurement.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can hold send and ACK times constant while varying the reported delay and verify that the raw sample is unchanged.

requirements.quote:
While the reported acknowledgment delay is not used by
   the RTT sample measurement, it is used to adjust the RTT sample in
   subsequent computations of smoothed_rtt and rttvar (Section 5.3).
requirements.condition: The endpoint subsequently computes smoothed_rtt and rttvar from an RTT sample associated with a reported acknowledgment delay.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the reported acknowledgment delay to adjust the RTT sample in those subsequent computations.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Ignore the reported acknowledgment delay when the applicable smoothed_rtt and rttvar adjustment is performed.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled acknowledgment-delay values and timing inputs allow observation of whether later smoothed_rtt and rttvar calculations apply the delay adjustment.

requirements.quote:
To avoid generating multiple RTT samples for a single packet, an ACK
   frame SHOULD NOT be used to update RTT estimates if it does not newly
   acknowledge the largest acknowledged packet.
requirements.condition: An ACK frame does not newly acknowledge its largest acknowledged packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Do not use that ACK frame to update RTT estimates.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use that ACK frame to update RTT estimates.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is prescribed; the frame is excluded from RTT-estimate updates.
requirements.why_checkable: A duplicate or otherwise non-new largest acknowledgment can be injected and RTT estimator state checked for an update.

requirements.quote:
An RTT sample MUST NOT be generated on receiving an ACK frame that
   does not newly acknowledge at least one ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.condition: A received ACK frame does not newly acknowledge at least one ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Do not generate an RTT sample from that ACK frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Generate an RTT sample from that ACK frame.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is prescribed; the frame is ignored for RTT sampling.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver an ACK that newly acknowledges no ack-eliciting packet and verify that no RTT sample is emitted and estimator sampling state does not advance.
